Varghese, Indrans, and Kunchan.  The music was composed by Suresh Peters and S.P. Venkatesh, the former composing the songs making his debut as a film composer and the latter composing the score.  The film was released as a grand Onam release on the day of Thiruvonam in 1998 (4 September), and became a huge blockbuster being the third highest grossing Malayalam film of 1998 after "Harikrishnans" and "Summer in Bethlehem".
Mayabazar: Music from the Motion Picture | Mayabazar: Music from the Motion Picture is the soundtrack album of the 1957 Indian bilingual film of the same name which was simultaneously shot in Telugu and Tamil.  Ghantasala composed the album and the background score for the film.  The soundtrack album features 12 tracks, whose lyrics were penned by Pingali Nagendrarao and Thanjai N.
